custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the reflection continuity. In AI-generated metal, reflections often 'break' or swirl unnaturally across ridges. Verify if the reflections on the left and right sides of the median ridge are symmetrical and physically plausible given a single light source. Also, check the rivet patterns for repetition or irregular spacing.
